name: What materials are used for new pipes during a rerouting project?

mainEntity.name: What materials are used for new pipes during a rerouting project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When rerouting pipes, common materials used include PEX (cross-linked polyethylene) and copper. PEX is flexible, corrosion-resistant, and typically more cost-effective for installation, often requiring fewer fittings. Copper is durable, long-lasting, and offers good water pressure. A practical tradeoff involves considering that while copper has a higher upfront material cost, its longevity and recyclability can be appealing, whereas PEX's flexibility can reduce labor time and cost, especially in difficult-to-access areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common materials are PEX, known for flexibility and cost-effectiveness, and copper, valued for durability and longevity.
